findings.title: Public member lists are truncated with no way to fetch subsequent pages
findings.body: The public group members route now calls findMembers(), which requests only 50 members by default, but the public members template has no pagination controls or load-more mechanism. Previously non-automatic groups returned their complete membership. For groups with more than 50 members, users can now see only the first 50 and cannot access the remaining members through this page. Add pagination to the public page alongside the newly paginated endpoint.

findings.title: Exact multiples of the page size produce an extra empty page
findings.body: totalPages uses floor(user_count / limit) + 1, so a group with exactly 50 members and a limit of 50 reports two pages. Next remains enabled on the only populated page and fetches offset 50, displaying an empty member list. Use ceiling division for nonzero counts so exact multiples do not create a phantom final page.

findings.title: Existing PATCH membership requests silently hide groups instead of updating membership
findings.body: The resources route still accepts PATCH /admin/groups/:id, but update no longer dispatches PATCH requests to the incremental membership handler. An existing client sending changes: {add: username} or changes: {delete: username} now has its membership changes ignored, while the unconditional visible assignment sets the group to false because that payload has no visible parameter. The request then returns success. Preserve the existing PATCH contract or explicitly reject obsolete membership payloads without changing group visibility.
